It's not as if he has revealed something which is unknown in the public domain.
But it's the open admission that earned him a round of applause at a function, organised by "Rashtriya Navanirmana Vedike", to mark the 87th birth anniversary of former Chief Minister Ramakrishna Hegde.
"There is a world of difference between the politics practiced during Hegde's regime and now".
Higher Education Minister R V Deshpande, a close associate of the former Chief Minister at the time.
